countries <- rnaturalearth::countries110 %>%
  st_transform(eqdc)


states <- USAboundaries::us_states(resolution = "low") %>%
  filter(!state_abbr %in% c("HI", "AK", "PR")) %>%
  st_transform(eqdc)


cities <- read_csv("/Users/jessicamagalit/Documents/AM 330/Lab-10/data/us_cities.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!state_id %in% c("HI", "AK", "PR")) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lng", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(eqdc)

library(flextable)

library(tibble)


united_states <- st_union(states) %>%
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%
  st_as_sf()

canada <- countries %>%
  filter(NAME_SORT == "Canada") %>%          
  st_union() %>%                              
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%          
  st_as_sf()

mexico <- countries %>%
  filter(NAME_SORT == "Mexico") %>%          
  st_union() %>%                              
  st_cast("MULTILINESTRING") %>%          
  st_as_sf()


states_union <- st_union(states)


state_borders <- st_boundary(states_union)
state_borders <- st_cast(state_borders, "MULTILINESTRING")


projected_crs <- 5070
states <- st_transform(states, projected_crs)
cities <- st_transform(cities, projected_crs)
state_borders <- st_transform(state_borders, projected_crs)


cities$dist_to_border <- st_distance(cities, state_borders)

cities$dist_to_border_km <- set_units(cities$dist_to_border, "km") %>%
  drop_units() %>%
  round(2)

cities$dist_to_natl_border <- st_distance(cities, united_states)

cities$dist_to_natl_border_km <- set_units(cities$dist_to_natl_border, "km") %>%
  drop_units() %>%
  round(2)

cities_df <- as.data.frame(cities)


farthest_cities <- cities_df %>%
  dplyr::select(city = city, state = state_name, distance = dist_to_border_km, geometry = geometry) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(distance)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:5)


flextable(farthest_cities) %>% 
  autofit()

Question 3

us_big_cities = cities %>% 
  slice_max(population, n = 10) %>% 
  st_transform(5070)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_big_cities, fill = "red") +
  geom_sf(data = united_states, fill = "beige", lty = 2, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_sf(data = state_line$geometry, color = "maroon", size = 1) + 
  geom_label_repel(data = us_big_cities, 
                   aes(x = st_coordinates(us_big_cities)[,1], 
                       y = st_coordinates(us_big_cities)[,2], 
                       label = city), 
                   box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.3, 
                   max.overlaps = 10, size = 3, segment.color = 'gray')









ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = cities, fill = "black", aes(color = (dist_to_natl_border_km[, 1]))) + 
  geom_sf(data = farthest_cities, fill = "red") +
  geom_sf(data = united_states, fill = "beige", lty = 2, linewidth = 1) +

    data = farthest_cities,

  filter(as.numeric(dist_to_natl_border_km) < 160)


hundocitiespop = sum(hundocities$population)

print(hundocitiespop)

[1] 255352985


255,352,985 / 341,707,410 = 0.747 –> 74.7% of Americans live within 100 miles of the border. This doesn’t match the ACLU estimate of two-thirds and is considerably higher.

top10_in_zone <- hundocities %>%
   slice_max(population, n = 10)


ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = hundocities, aes(color = dist_to_natl_border_km), fill = "black") +
